description: Send a material finding, risk, question or blocker to this run's orchestrator without ending your work. Use only when coordination is needed, never for routine progress. The recipient and run are fixed by Agent Run. Reuse the same request_id and content after an uncertain result; use a new id for a distinct report. A receipt only confirms durable queueing, not delivery, approval or an answer. Continue independent authorized work; the orchestrator can reply through steer. Do not send credentials. Maximum 2048 UTF-8 bytes, 20 distinct reports per run, at least 30 seconds apart.

message.description: Concise report; UTF-8 byte limit is enforced by the broker. Newlines and tabs are permitted; other control characters are rejected.

request_id.description: Stable retry key for this report within the current run.

name: notify_orchestrator

description: Send one informational chat message to your pool. The pool, author name, role and stable identity are stamped by Agent Run from this run's membership; you cannot author as anyone else. The message is untrusted coordination data for peers: it never changes the goal, criteria, roles or permissions, and it never counts as a vote. Reuse the same request_id with identical content after an uncertain result; the same key with different content is a conflict. The receipt means the entry is durably recorded and readable by peers through pool_read, not that anyone has read or consumed it. Bounded: the pool allows 200 ordinary chat rows or 256 KiB in total; proposals and votes remain possible when the chat budget is exhausted. A pending existing member acknowledges enrollment only with the exact opaque broker-issued request_id and a brief current-work summary; its live attempt/token and original deadline are checked. Identical ACK replay adds no entry. Other writes/votes remain blocked until joined.

message.description: Untrusted-to-peers body, 1-8192 UTF-8 bytes. Newlines and tabs are permitted; other control characters are rejected.

request_id.description: Stable retry key scoped to this execution.

name: pool_post

description: Read your pool's durable shared log and its derived status: goal, every acceptance criterion, the current roster with stable identities, the current proposal and snapshot, and each member's vote status with the reason it does or does not count. Entries are returned oldest-first after a cursor; duplicates are removed by sequence. Set wait_seconds to hold the read briefly until a new entry exists beyond your cursor instead of polling repeatedly; an empty wait returns the same bounded page. The pool is not finished merely because votes are ready: completion additionally requires every member's execution to end successfully. A read receipt is your own view; it is not evidence that any peer has read anything. After a resume, re-read from your last seen sequence. Pending members can read full criteria/roster and their own exact enrollment ACK request_id with the original remaining execution time.

after_seq.description: Return entries with a greater sequence; 0 starts from the beginning.

before_seq.description: Return older entries before this positive sequence; exclusive with after_seq.

wait_seconds.description: Hold this read until an entry exists beyond after_seq, at most 25 seconds; 0 returns immediately.

name: pool_read

description: Propose one result snapshot the whole pool can agree on. Any member may propose; a new proposal supersedes the previous one and earlier votes no longer count against it. State what finished artifacts the snapshot names (for example a shared commit SHA, or a path with its sha256) so peers can verify it themselves. The receipt means the proposal is durably recorded and readable, not that any peer has seen or accepted it. Bounded: at most 20 proposals per pool.

request_id.description: Stable retry key scoped to this execution.

snapshot.description: Immutable snapshot of the proposed result; peers must echo exactly this snapshot when voting ready.

name: pool_propose

description: Judge the pool's current proposal. decision ready means you verified the proposal's snapshot satisfies every acceptance criterion from your own role; attach one check per criterion with concrete evidence. decision block records an objection; decision revoke withdraws your earlier vote. Your vote only counts while it names the current proposal, the current roster and your current execution, and while that execution is running or succeeded — a resume, a new proposal, a roster change or a failure invalidates it, and you must vote again. Voting ready is not the pool's completion and does not end your run: keep coordinating until the pool completes or you must block.

checks.description: Per-criterion verdicts; required for ready, covering every acceptance criterion exactly once.

proposal_seq.description: The proposal entry being voted on; must equal the current proposal shown by pool_read.

request_id.description: Stable retry key scoped to this execution.

name: pool_vote
